expectations.text: Does not teach all points at once or produce a long lecture

notes: Borderline on minimality: the block adds a prerequisite matrix-vector rule and the 'one-sentence' principle runs to two sentences; overall reply is long (~1000 non-space chars) because of the outline, pacing paragraph and a meta paragraph justifying predict-then-verify.
